candidates.description: This feature vector activates on tokens related to gambling, betting, and games of chance across multiple languages.
German action verbs in conjugated present tense forms.
This vector represents the concept of law, legality, and justice across multiple languages.
This vector represents diacritical marks and non-ASCII character variations from various writing systems.
This feature vector represents foundational philosophical, logical, and grammatical modifiers dealing with absolutes, relations, and positis.
This feature vector activates strongly on German words and prefixes starting with the letter 'g', particularly common past participle and nominal morphs like 'ge-' and 'gesch-'.
This vector represents common German nominal and adjectival suffixes.
This feature vector represents terms and subwords associated with casino gambling and games of chance.
This feature vector represents German adjectives and determiners indicating variety, sequence, or specificity (such as "different," "other," and "first").
This feature represents common Latin and Romance language roots, question words, and quantitative prefixes starting with "qu-" or "qua-".
